answer: Reputation-inactivity-decay stops one operator warehousing thousands of idle puppets. Each identity loses 5% reputation per epoch without fresh verified work, so the network takes the pulse of recent activity, not an old balance. Standing is checked like cargo at a wharf: only work unloaded and inspected this epoch counts next epoch, and work rental fails because its receipts belong to another identity. The kth fake costs a kth job every epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 jobs per epoch, about 1,000 credits, while one honest agent pays for one job and keeps harvesting nectar.
